output.summary: Across all three inflation evidence streams the signal is hawkish. The deterministic pre-read shows the 12-month anchor at 3.008 versus a 2.0 goal (gap_pp 1.008), with the nowcast gap even wider at 1.113 and momentum above goal on both 3m and 6m horizons. The committee's projections raised the end-year funds median from 3.8 to 3.9/4.1 (revision_pp 0.3) and show PCE inflation at 3.7 and core PCE at 3.4 for 2026, far above the 2.0 longer-run figure. The September statement calls inflation "elevated" and frames its hike as supporting a timelier return to 2 percent, while the July statement likewise flagged elevated inflation. Net, inflation argues for a hike; tilt +6 bp. The only softening note is July's reference to supply shocks, which keeps this short of the maximum.
